lessons.titleUz: Past Perfect va Past Perfect Continuous
objectivesUz: O'tmishdagi ikki voqeadan qaysi biri oldin sodir bo'lganini Past Perfect bilan ko'rsatish
Past Perfect Continuous orqali o'tmishdagi paytgacha davom etgan jarayonni ifodalash
by the time, after, before, already, for/since signal so'zlari bilan ishonchli ishlash

content.bodyUz:
O'tmishda IKKITA voqea bo'lsa, qaysi biri OLDIN sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect ishlatiladi: **had + V3**.

*When we arrived at the cinema, the film **had started**.* — Biz kinoteatrga yetib kelganimizda, film (bizdan OLDIN) boshlanib bo'lgan edi.

Agar ikkala voqea shunchaki ketma-ket aytilsa, ikkalasi ham Past Simple bo'ladi: *I came home and went to bed.* Past Perfect faqat tartibni TA'KIDLASH kerak bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: *by the time, after, before, already, just, never ... before*.

content.titleUz: Past Perfect Continuous: natijagacha davom etgan jarayon
content.bodyUz:
**had been + V-ing** — o'tmishdagi bir paytgacha DAVOM ETGAN jarayonni bildiradi. Ko'pincha *for/since* bilan davomiylik ko'rsatiladi yoki ko'rinib turgan natija-iz tushuntiriladi:

*She **had been working** at the hospital **for ten years** when she got the promotion.* — Lavozimi ko'tarilganda u kasalxonada o'n yildan beri ishlab kelayotgan edi.

*The ground was wet — it **had been raining** all night.* — Yer ho'l edi — tun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'ib chiqqan edi (natija-iz: ho'l yer).

Diqqat: holat fe'llari (*know, believe, own, love*) continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi: *I **had known** him for years* ("had been knowing" emas).

content.bodyUz:
**will be + V-ing** — kelajakdagi MA'LUM PAYTDA davom etib turadigan harakatni bildiradi:

*This time tomorrow, I **will be flying** to Istanbul.* — Ertaga shu paytda men Istanbulga uchib ketayotgan bo'laman.

*Don't call at 8 — we **will be having** dinner.* — Soat 8 da qo'ng'iroq qilma — kechki ovqat yeb o'tirgan bo'lamiz.

Shuningdek, tabiiy ravishda rejalashtirilgan ishlar uchun ham ishlatiladi: *I**'ll be seeing** Karim at the office anyway, so I can pass on your message.* — Karimni baribir ofisda ko'raman, xabaringni yetkazib qo'yaman.

**will have + V3** — kelajakdagi muayyan muddatGACHA tugallanib bo'ladigan ishni bildiradi. Asosiy signal: **by** (…gacha): *by the time, by 2030, by the end of the year*.

*By 2030, the company **will have opened** fifty new branches.* — 2030-yilga borib kompaniya ellikta yangi filial ochib bo'ladi.

Jarayonning davomiyligini ta'kidlash uchun **Future Perfect Continuous** ishlatiladi: *By May, she **will have been living** in London for a year.* — May oyiga kelib u Londonda bir yildan beri yashayotgan bo'ladi.

content.titleUz: Third Conditional: o'tmishdagi ro'y bermagan voqea
content.bodyUz:
**If + Past Perfect, ... would have + V3** — o'tmishda BO'LMAGAN voqeani tasavvur qilish va uning o'tmishdagi natijasi haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu — «afsuslanish grammatikasi»:

*If you **had told** me about the problem, I **would have helped** you.* — Muammo haqida aytganingda edi, senga yordam bergan bo'lardim. (Aslida: aytmading — yordam bermadim.)

*would* o'rniga *could* (imkoniyat) yoki *might* (ehtimol) ham keladi: *If we had left earlier, we **could have caught** the train.* — Ertaroq chiqqanimizda poyezdga ulgurishimiz mumkin edi.

items.en: He might have passed the interview if he had prepared properly.
items.uz: To'g'ri tayyorgarlik ko'rganida edi, suhbatdan o'tishi mumkin edi.

content.titleUz: Mixed Conditional: o'tmish va hozirni bog'lash
content.bodyUz:
Aralash shart gaplar ikki zamonni bog'laydi:

**1) O'tmishdagi sabab → hozirgi natija**: *If + Past Perfect, ... would + V1*
*If I **had saved** my money, I **would be** rich now.* — Pulimni jamg'arganimda edi, hozir boy bo'lardim.

**2) Hozirgi (doimiy) holat → o'tmishdagi natija**: *If + Past Simple, ... would have + V3*
*If he **weren't** so shy, he **would have spoken** to her yesterday.* — U shunchalik tortinchoq bo'lmaganida, kecha u qiz bilan gaplashgan bo'lardi.

Kalit: har bir qismdagi VAQT belgisiga qarang (*now, today* — hozirgi natija; *yesterday, last year* — o'tmishdagi natija).

Imtihon taktikasi: shart gap savolida avval IKKALA qismdagi vaqt ko'rsatkichlarini toping. Natija qismida *now / today* bo'lsa — would + V1, *yesterday / last week* bo'lsa — would have + V3. Multilevel'da aralash shartlar aynan shu «vaqt tuzog'i» bilan tekshiriladi: talabalarning ko'pchiligi if qismiga qarab shablonni yodaki qo'yadi va xato qiladi — siz esa vaqt belgisiga qarang.

content.titleUz: wish + Past Simple: hozirgi holatdan afsus
content.bodyUz:
Hozirgi holat yoqmasa va uni o'zgartirishni istasak: **wish + Past Simple**. E'tibor bering: zamon ORQAGA suriladi — hozirgi holat haqida o'tgan zamon bilan gapiramiz:

*I **wish** I **had** more free time.* — Ko'proq bo'sh vaqtim bo'lishini istardim (hozir yo'q).

*be* fe'li bilan rasmiy uslubda barcha shaxslarda **were** ishlatiladi: *I wish I **were** taller. She wishes she **were** in Paris now.*

content.titleUz: wish + Past Perfect: o'tmishdagi xatodan afsus
content.bodyUz:
O'tmishda qilgan (yoki qilmagan) ishimizdan afsuslanish: **wish + Past Perfect**:

*I **wish** I **had studied** harder at school.* — Maktabda yaxshiroq o'qimaganimdan afsusdaman.

*She **wishes** she **hadn't sold** her car.* — U mashinasini sotganidan afsusda.

**If only** xuddi shu qoliplar bilan ishlaydi, lekin his-tuyg'uni KUCHLIROQ ifodalaydi: *If only I had listened to my parents!* — Qaniydi ota-onamning gapiga quloq solganimda!

Boshqa odamlarning (yoki vaziyatning) bizni bezovta qiladigan odatiga norozilik bildirish: **wish + would**:

*I **wish** you **would stop** interrupting me.* — Gapimni bo'lishni bas qilishingni istardim.

*I **wish** it **would stop** raining.* — Qaniydi yomg'ir tinsa.

Diqqat: o'zimiz haqimizda *wish + would* ishlatilMAYDI (*I wish I would...* — xato), chunki bu qolip boshqa birovning irodasiga qaratilgan bo'ladi.

content.bodyUz:
Ishni O'ZIMIZ emas, boshqa birov (usta, sartarosh, tikuvchi) biz uchun bajarsa: **have + obyekt + V3**:

*I **had my hair cut** yesterday.* — Kecha sochimni oldirdim (sartaroshda).

*We're **having our flat renovated** at the moment.* — Hozir kvartiramizni ta'mirlatyapmiz.

Norasmiy uslubda *have* o'rniga *get* keladi: *I need to **get my laptop repaired**.* — Noutbukimni tuzattirishim kerak.

Solishtiring: *I cut my hair* (o'zim oldim) va *I had my hair cut* (oldirdim — boshqa odam oldi). Ma'no butunlay boshqacha!

content.titleUz: It is said that... / He is believed to...: shaxssiz passiv
content.bodyUz:
Rasmiy va akademik uslubda manbasi umumiy bo'lgan fikrlar ikki qolipda beriladi:

**1) It + passiv + that...**: *People say that the water is polluted.* → ***It is said that** the water is polluted.* — Aytishlaricha, suv ifloslangan.

**2) Ega + passiv + to V**: *The water **is said to be** polluted.* — xuddi shu ma'no, lekin gap suvdan boshlanadi.

O'tmishdagi ish uchun **perfect infinitive (to have + V3)** ishlatiladi: *He **is believed to have left** the country in 2020.* — U 2020-yilda mamlakatni tark etgan deb hisoblanadi.

Shu qolipda keladigan fe'llar: *say, think, believe, know, expect, report, consider*.

lessons.titleEn: Advanced relative clauses: defining vs non-defining, whose/whom
objectivesUz: Defining va non-defining relative clause farqini vergul orqali ko'rsatish

Qaysi holatlarda that ishlatib bo'lmasligini aniq bilish

content.bodyUz:
**Defining relative clause** — gapdan olib tashlab BO'LMAYDIGAN, ma'noni aniqlab beradigan qism. Vergul QO'YILMAYDI:

*The woman **who lives next door** is a doctor.* — Yonimizda yashaydigan ayol — shifokor. (Qaysi ayol? — yonimizda yashaydigani. Bu ma'lumotsiz gap tushunarsiz.)

Bu turda *who/which* o'rniga **that** ishlatish mumkin: *The book **that** you lent me is fascinating.* Olmosh to'ldiruvchi vazifasida bo'lsa, uni tushirish ham mumkin: *The book you lent me is fascinating.*

**Non-defining relative clause** — QO'SHIMCHA ma'lumot; olib tashlansa ham gap ma'nosi saqlanadi. Ikki tomondan VERGUL bilan ajratiladi:

*My father, **who is 62**, still plays tennis.* — Otam, 62 yoshda bo'lishiga qaramay, hali ham tennis o'ynaydi.

Muhim qoidalar:
1. Bu turda **that ishlatib bo'lmaydi** (*My father, that is 62,...* — xato).
2. Olmoshni tushirib ham bo'lmaydi.
3. **which** butun gapga ishora qilishi mumkin: *He passed the exam with a high score, **which** surprised everyone.* — U imtihondan yuqori ball bilan o'tdi, bu hammani hayratda qoldirdi.

**whose** — egalik (kimning/nimaning): *That's the artist **whose** paintings sold for a million dollars.* — Rasmlari million dollarga sotilgan rassom shu.

**whom** — rasmiy uslubda to'ldiruvchi vazifasidagi shaxs, ayniqsa predlogdan keyin: *The candidate **to whom** you spoke has been hired.* — Siz gaplashgan nomzod ishga olindi.

**where** — joy: *the city **where** I was born*; **when** — vaqt: *the day **when** we met*.

Rasmiy yozuvda predlog + which ham ishlatiladi: *the house **in which** he grew up* = *the house where he grew up*.

content.bodyUz:
Inversiya — urg'u berish uchun gap boshiga inkor yoki cheklovchi ibora chiqarilib, so'ng SAVOL TARTIBI (yordamchi fe'l + ega) ishlatilishi:

*I have never seen such a crowd.* → ***Never have I seen** such a crowd.* — Bunday olomonni hech qachon ko'rmaganman.

Bu rasmiy va ta'sirchan uslub: nutqlar, esselar, adabiy matnlar. Writing Task 2 da o'rinli ishlatilgan bitta inversiya grammatik diapazon (grammatical range) balini sezilarli oshiradi.

Yodda tuting: oddiy zamonlarda (Present/Past Simple) yordamchi **do/does/did** qo'shiladi: *Rarely **does he** admit his mistakes.* — U xatolarini kamdan-kam tan oladi.

content.bodyUz:
1. **Yordamchi fe'lni unutish**: *Never I have seen...* — xato. To'g'ri: *Never **have I** seen...*

2. **Juftlikni adashtirish**: *Hardly* doim **when** bilan, *No sooner* doim **than** bilan keladi: *Hardly had I arrived **when**... / No sooner had I arrived **than**...*

3. **Not only'dan keyin tartib**: inversiya faqat BIRINCHI qismda bo'ladi: *Not only **did he** apologise, but he **also sent** flowers.* — ikkinchi qismda oddiy tartib qoladi.

4. Hardly/No sooner qoliplarida deyarli har doim **Past Perfect** ishlatiladi (*Hardly **had** I...*), chunki ikki voqea ketma-ket keladi.

Imtihon taktikasi: grammatika bo'limida gap Not only / Hardly / No sooner / Never bilan boshlansa, undan keyin ALBATTA yordamchi fe'l + ega tartibi kelishini tekshiring — variantlardan aynan shu tartibdagisini tanlang. Writing'da esseda 1-2 tadan ko'p inversiya ishlatmang: me'yorida — mahorat, ko'p bo'lsa — sun'iylik. Eng xavfsiz tanlov: xulosada *Not only ... but also* bilan ikkita asosiy dalilingizni birlashtirish.

content.bodyUz:
**Skimming** — matnning har bir so'zini o'qimasdan, UMUMIY G'OYANI ilg'ash texnikasi. Qanday qilinadi:

1. **Sarlavha**ni o'qing — mavzuni beradi.
2. **Birinchi xatboshi**ni to'liq o'qing — asosiy g'oya odatda shu yerda.
3. Har xatboshining **birinchi (topic) gapini** o'qing.
4. **Oxirgi xatboshi**ga ko'z tashlang — xulosa.

Maqsad: 90-120 soniyada «Bu matn nima haqida? Muallifning pozitsiyasi qanday?» savollariga javob topish. «Main idea / best title / writer's purpose» savollari aynan skimming bilan yechiladi.

**Scanning** — matndan ANIQ MA'LUMOTNI (sana, ism, raqam, atama) tez topish. Qanday qilinadi:

1. Avval SAVOLNI o'qing va kalit so'zni belgilang (masalan: *2030, Navoi, 25%*).
2. Matnni o'qimang — ko'zingizni matn bo'ylab yurgizib, faqat shu kalit so'zni (yoki uning parafrazini) izlang. Raqamlar va bosh harfli so'zlar ko'zga tez tashlanadi.
3. Kalit so'z topilgach, o'sha gapni va yonidagi 1-2 gapni DIQQAT bilan o'qing — javob shu yerda.

«What year...? How many...? Who...? Where...?» savollari — scanning savollari.

content.titleUz: Mashq matni: Solar Power in Uzbekistan
content.bodyUz:
Quyidagi matn ustida ishlaymiz. Avval 90 soniya SKIMMING qiling (sarlavha + har xatboshining birinchi gapi), so'ng mashqlardagi savollarga scanning bilan javob toping.

*Uzbekistan, a country blessed with more than 300 sunny days a year, is rapidly becoming one of Central Asia's leaders in solar energy. In 2021, the country opened its first large-scale solar plant in the Navoi region, capable of producing 100 megawatts of electricity. Since then, the government has signed agreements with international companies to build additional plants in Samarkand, Jizzakh and Surkhandarya. Officials hope that by 2030, renewable sources will provide 25 per cent of the country's electricity.*

*There are several reasons for this ambitious plan. First, demand for electricity is growing by around seven per cent every year as the population and the economy expand. Second, natural gas, which currently generates most of the country's power, is increasingly needed for export and for industry. Finally, solar power has become dramatically cheaper: the cost of panels has fallen by almost 90 per cent since 2010.*

*However, experts warn that challenges remain. The national grid, much of which was built in the Soviet era, requires modernisation before it can handle large amounts of renewable energy. In addition, the country will need thousands of trained engineers to install and maintain the new technology.*

Imtihon taktikasi: Multilevel Reading'da vaqt — eng katta dushman. Har bir matnga formulani qo'llang: 1) 90 soniya skimming; 2) savollarni o'qib, turini aniqlang (umumiy g'oyami yoki faktmi); 3) fakt-savollarni scanning bilan yeching; 4) bitta qiyin savolga 60 soniyadan ko'p sarflamang — belgilab qo'yib, keyingisiga o'ting. Hech qachon javobni bo'sh qoldirmang: noto'g'ri javob uchun ball KESILMAYDI.

content.titleUz: Signal so'zlar: javob kelayotganini e'lon qiladi
content.bodyUz:
Audioda javoblar tasodifiy joyda kelmaydi — ularni **signal so'zlar** e'lon qiladi. Eng muhimlari:

1. **Burilish signallari** (*but, however, actually, in fact, unfortunately*) — oldin aytilgan ma'lumot O'ZGARADI. Javob deyarli har doim signaldan KEYIN keladi.
2. **Yakuniy qaror signallari** (*in the end, eventually, finally, so we decided*) — bir nechta variant aytilgach, qaysi biri tanlangani.
3. **Sabab signallari** (*because, since, the reason is, that's why*) — «Why...?» savollarining javobi.

Oltin qoida: gapiruvchi AVVAL aytgan narsasi ko'pincha TUZOQ (distractor), signaldan keyingi ma'lumot — JAVOB.

rows: reja yoki fikr o'zgardi — javob keyin keladi
also, what's more, on top of that
so, all in all, to sum up

content.bodyUz:
Savoldagi so'zlar audioda AYNAN takrorlanmaydi — ma'no boshqa so'zlar bilan beriladi. Transkript misolini ko'ring:

**Savol:** *What time did the woman's train leave?*
**Audio (transkript):** *«I was planning to take the nine o'clock train to Samarkand, but the tickets were sold out, so in the end I caught the half past ten one instead.»*

**Tahlil:** 9:00 — tuzoq (reja edi, *but* uni bekor qildi). Javob: **10:30** (*in the end* signalidan keyin, «half past ten» parafrazida).

Yana bir misol:
**Savol:** *Is the museum free?*
**Audio:** *«Entrance won't cost you anything, though you'll need to book online.»*
**Tahlil:** *free* so'zi aytilmadi, lekin *won't cost you anything* = *free*. Javob: ha, bepul.

content.bodyUz: Imtihon taktikasi: audio boshlanishidan oldin beriladigan 30-45 soniyada savollarni o'qib, kalit so'zlar tagiga chizing va parafrazlarini tasavvur qiling (free → cost nothing). Audio paytida raqam eshitsangiz darhol yozib qo'ying, lekin oxirgi eshitilgan raqam har doim ham javob emas — *but / in the end* signallarini kuting. Bitta savolni o'tkazib yuborsangiz, unga qaytib o'ylanib qolmang: keyingi savolning signalini ham boy berasiz.

exercises.promptUz: Transkriptni o'qing va savolga javob bering:

data.text: Transkript: «I used to go swimming every morning, but these days I mostly go jogging in the park.» — Savol: What does the speaker usually do now?

exercises.explanationUz: «But» signalidan keyin hozirgi odat aytildi: jogging. Swimming — o'tmishdagi odat (used to), ya'ni tuzoq-distractor.

exercises.promptUz: Transkriptni o'qing va savolga javob bering:

exercises.explanationUz: 2:00 — reja (was supposed to — tuzoq), «but» dan keyin: yigirma daqiqa kechikdi → 2:20. Hisoblash talab qilinadigan savollar Listening'da ko'p.
Har bir signal o'z turkumidagi savolga yo'l ko'rsatadi: however → o'zgargan ma'lumot, because → why-savol, therefore → xulosa.

lessons.titleUz: Essay tuzilishi: kirish, asosiy qism, xulosa
objectivesUz: 4 xatboshili essay strukturasini (kirish, 2 ta asosiy, xulosa) qo'llash
Kuchli thesis statement yozishni o'rganish
Har bir asosiy xatboshini PEEL formulasi bo'yicha qurish

content.bodyUz:
Writing Task 2 — berilgan mavzu bo'yicha **200-250 so'zlik** essay. Ko'pincha fikr bildirish (opinion) yoki ikki tomonni muhokama qilish (discussion) so'raladi. Baholash mezonlari: vazifani bajarish, matn izchilligi, so'z boyligi va grammatika.

Oltin struktura — **4 xatboshi**:
1. **Kirish** (3-4 gap): mavzuga olib kirish + thesis statement
2. **Asosiy xatboshi 1** (4-5 gap): eng kuchli dalil + misol
3. **Asosiy xatboshi 2** (4-5 gap): ikkinchi dalil + misol
4. **Xulosa** (2-3 gap): pozitsiyani boshqa so'zlar bilan takrorlash

**Thesis statement** — kirish xatboshisining OXIRGI gapi bo'lib, butun essayning yo'nalishini belgilaydi: sizning pozitsiyangiz + asosiy sabablar.

**Kuchsiz:** *Education is very important in our life.* (umumiy gap, pozitsiya yo'q)

**Kuchli:** *This essay will argue that studying abroad benefits young people because it develops independence and improves career prospects.* (aniq pozitsiya + ikki sabab = ikki asosiy xatboshining tayyor rejasi!)

Kuchli thesis yozsangiz, asosiy qism o'z-o'zidan rejalanadi: har bir sabab — bitta xatboshi.

Har bir asosiy xatboshini **PEEL** bo'yicha quring:

- **P**oint (fikr): topic sentence — xatboshining birinchi gapi. *One major advantage of studying abroad is that it develops independence.*
- **E**xplain (izohlash): nima uchun bu to'g'ri? *Living far from family forces students to manage their own money, time and daily problems.*
- **E**xample (misol): aniq misol. *For example, my cousin, who studied in Germany, learned to cook and budget within months.*
- **L**ink (bog'lash): xulosa-gap yoki keyingi xatboshiga ko'prik. *As a result, such students mature much faster than their peers.*

Xulosa xatboshisi esa thesis'ni YANGI so'zlar bilan takrorlaydi va yangi dalil KIRITMAYDI.

content.bodyUz: Imtihon taktikasi: 30 daqiqani shunday taqsimlang — 5 daqiqa reja (thesis + ikkita dalil + misollar), 20 daqiqa yozish, 5 daqiqa tekshirish (qisqartmalar yo'qmi, so'z soni yetarlimi, har xatboshida topic sentence bormi). 200 so'zdan kam yozish — eng qimmat xato: vazifa to'liq bajarilmagan hisoblanadi. Rejasiz boshlamang: reja qog'ozda 5 daqiqa oladi, kallada esa 15 daqiqa yo'qotadi.

lessons.titleUz: Formal so'z boyligi: get → obtain, big → significant
objectivesUz: 30 ta kundalik so'zning rasmiy muqobilini o'rganish
Essay va rasmiy xatlarda formal leksikadan o'rinli foydalanish
Phrasal verblarni bir so'zli rasmiy fe'llarga almashtirish

content.bodyUz:
Writing baholashda **so'z boyligi (lexical resource)** alohida mezon. *get, big, a lot of, kids* — og'zaki nutqda normal, lekin essayda ular balingizni B1 darajasida ushlab turadi. Xuddi shu fikr rasmiy so'zlar bilan B2-C1 taassurotini beradi:

**Oddiy:** *Students get a lot of good things from studying abroad.*
**Rasmiy:** *Students obtain significant benefits from studying abroad.*

Uch qoida: 1) phrasal verblarni bir so'zli fe'lga almashtiring (*find out → discover*), 2) qisqartmalardan voz keching (*don't → do not*), 3) umumiy sifatlarni aniqroq rasmiy sifatga almashtiring (*good → beneficial*).

content.titleUz: 15 ta sifat, ot va bog'lovchi juftligi

items.en: We found out that kids need a lot of help. → We discovered that children require considerable assistance.
items.uz: Bolalarga ko'p yordam kerakligini aniqladik — bitta gapda uchta so'z rasmiylashtirildi.

items.en: The company put off the meeting because there wasn't enough time. → The company postponed the meeting because there was insufficient time.
items.uz: Kompaniya vaqt yetarli emasligi sababli yig'ilishni keyinga surdi.

items.en: Prices went up a lot, so people bought less. → Prices increased significantly; therefore, people purchased less.
items.uz: Narxlar sezilarli oshdi, shu sababli xaridlar kamaydi.

items.en: It's a big chance to get a good job. → It is a significant opportunity to obtain a rewarding occupation.
items.uz: Bu munosib kasb egallash uchun katta imkoniyat.

content.bodyUz: Imtihon taktikasi: essayda har bir xatboshiga kamida 2-3 ta rasmiy so'z joylashtiring, lekin me'yorni saqlang — butun gapni «qiyin» so'zlardan qurish sun'iy ko'rinadi va xato ehtimolini oshiradi. Eng foydali beshlik: *significant, obtain, require, therefore, however* — deyarli har qanday mavzuga tushadi. Yozib bo'lgach, 30 soniya sarflab matndan *get / big / a lot of / so* so'zlarini qidiring va almashtiring — bu eng tez ball oshirish usuli.

exercises.explanationUz: get → obtain, buy → purchase, need → require, find out → discover — essayda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan to'rt almashtirish.
big → significant, bad → detrimental, cheap → inexpensive, enough → sufficient. Detrimental — «zararli» ma'nosidagi kuchli akademik sifat.
